seed_commits.message:
chore: initial package scaffold

src layout, pyproject, Docker and a CI skeleton. No library code yet.
seed_commits.author: Ingrid Halvorsen <ingrid.halvorsen@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(schema): infer column types from raw CSV text

Recognises the dozen spellings of missing that turn up in real exports.
Booleans are checked before integers because 0/1 parse as both.
seed_commits.author: Ingrid Halvorsen <ingrid.halvorsen@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(missing): add missing-value analysis and fit/transform imputation

Fill values are learned at fit time and held on the imputer, so transform is a
pure lookup. Recomputing during transform is how train/serve skew starts.
seed_commits.author: Tomas Vidal <tomas.vidal@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(outliers): add IQR, z-score and modified z-score detection

No default method: the two disagree on skewed data, so the caller should pick
deliberately. Quantiles are implemented here because libraries disagree on the
interpolation convention.
seed_commits.author: Tomas Vidal <tomas.vidal@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(scale): add standard, min-max and robust scalers

A constant column gets spread=1.0 so a pipeline cannot divide by zero.
seed_commits.author: Ingrid Halvorsen <ingrid.halvorsen@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(encode): add one-hot and ordinal encoding

Output width is fixed at fit time and the unseen-category policy is explicit,
so a consumer's column count cannot change with the batch.
seed_commits.author: Yara Mansour <yara.mansour@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(corr): add correlation and descriptive summaries

Constant series correlate as 0.0 rather than NaN, and coefficients are clamped
because float error can push a perfect correlation past 1.0.
seed_commits.author: Yara Mansour <yara.mansour@example.com>

seed_commits.message: feat(profile): assemble a whole-dataset profile with findings
seed_commits.author: Tomas Vidal <tomas.vidal@example.com>

seed_commits.message: feat(cli): add edakit profile and edakit missing
seed_commits.author: Yara Mansour <yara.mansour@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
test: cover inference, imputation, outliers, scaling and encoding

Numeric expectations are hand-computed with the derivation in the docstring, so
a failure means the maths changed rather than a snapshot drifting.
seed_commits.author: Ingrid Halvorsen <ingrid.halvorsen@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
test: add deliberately messy sample datasets

Mixed null spellings, unicode, an empty column and a data-entry error, so the
suite exercises what a synthetic fixture would let through.
seed_commits.author: Tomas Vidal <tomas.vidal@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
ci: run tests, doctests and a CLI smoke test

ci/run_ci.sh mirrors the workflow so the same steps run locally.
seed_commits.author: Ingrid Halvorsen <ingrid.halvorsen@example.com>

seed_commits.message: docs: document the fit/transform contract and the numeric choices
seed_commits.author: Yara Mansour <yara.mansour@example.com>
